text:
devon: FYI, new customer (acme-io) is ready to onboard in eu-north-2. They need p5s for inference and a mix of g5 for finetune. Can we open quota increases?
aziz: What counts are they asking for? exact instance types + ENI/vCPU?
devon: Requesting initial pool: p5.48xlarge x6, g5.48xlarge x10, p4d.24xlarge x2. ENI quota bump to at least 1200 for the account in eu-north-2 (they'll run multi-AZ). Target go-live: next Thu EOD (8 days).
rahul: Copy. I'll draft the support case. We need the AWS account ID and a business justification + cost center. Also confirm whether we want dedicated tenancy or shared.
devon: Account ID 123456789012, cost center INF-RED-11. Shared tenancy is fine for now; we may escalate to dedicated later. Business justification: low-latency inference for customer pilot, high-throughput streaming; will consume sustained capacity during weekday business hours.
aziz: Raise the service quotas: "Running On-Demand instances - p5.48xlarge" to 10, "Running On-Demand instances - g5.48xlarge" to 20, "Running On-Demand instances - p4d.24xlarge" to 4, and EC2-VPC IP addresses (ENIs) to 1200. Also request increase for "VPC Elastic Network Interfaces" and optionally EFA.
rahul: Case created: 123456789012-us-eun2-CASE0009876. Put that in the tenant onboarding tracker. Opening with AWS Support (business). Adding TAM and account rep.
tina: I'll notify the TAM and attach the workload diagram and traffic profile. Suggest adding a manual limit for EBS throughput if they attach many volumes.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: quota-request created by rahul at 1976543300. Status: pending support response.
aziz: What about soft limits for ENIs per instance family? Need to check per-region instance ENI attachments for p5/p4d/g5. If AWS needs VPC ENI limits per AZ, we might have to request per-AZ increases too.
rahul: Good catch. I'll ask AWS to raise per-AZ ENI allocation and verify instance network limits (p5 attaches 8 ENIs each).
devon: Also confirm AMI and driver readiness on p5 in eu-north-2 before we spin up. I can run a small smoke test once quota is approved.
aziz: Priority is to get at least 6 p5 and 10 g5 available by Tue. If AWS pushback, fallback plan is to route inference to eu-west-1 with lower latency for some traffic. Add routing rule in smart-router to failover to eu-west-1.
rahul: Noted. I've set the case priority to 'urgent' and included timeline. I'll post updates here when AWS responds.
devon: thx. tagging @tina for billing approvals.
tina: Approved budget for pilot up to $25k/month estimated. Please include estimate in the case.
ops-bot: support-update: AWS responded at 1976545100 asking for AZ distribution and expected sustained 24/7 vs burst. rahul: replied with expected steady-state of 60% utilization during weekdays, burst to 90% during experiments.
aziz: once quota is confirmed, schedule a small canary deploy and validate perf/kv-cache behavior on p5. devon -> can you own the canary?
devon: will do. I'll spin up one p5 and two g5 as soon as quota is live and post perf numbers here.
rahul: AWS approved partial increases: p5 -> 6, g5 -> 12, p4d -> 2, ENIs -> 1000. They asked to re-open for full capacity after initial proof. Case 123456789012-us-eun2-CASE0009876 CLOSED (provisioning in progress).
aziz: fine for now. I'll update the onboarding sheet and create follow-up to request the remaining capacity after canary completes.
devon: rolling to test cluster now. will report back with logs. :rocket:
